title: Chronotide
description: A time-bending dimension mod filled with fractured biomes, echoing bosses, and mysterious relics. AI-designed mod.
body:
# 🌀 Chronotide - Echoes Across Time

An AI-generated dimension mod where time fractures, echoes whisper secrets, and reality itself bends.

Step into the Chronotide, a mysterious realm where timelines have collided and fractured. Built entirely through collaboration with AI, this mod introduces a rich, immersive experience filled with:

-🌍 3 Unique Biomes

1-Frozen Echo Zone: A haunting, icy region frozen in a loop of time. Shattered glaciers hold the memories of battles long past.

2-Fractured Void: Gravity twists, the ground pulses—time is broken here. Expect the unexpected.

3-Temporal Ocean (Overworld biome): A sea of shimmering currents, where time flows like water and strange relics wash ashore.

-🛡️ Bosses & Enemies
Echo Warden (Final Boss): The guardian of the fractured timeline. Awaken it in the heart of Chronotide and prepare for an epic battle.

Time Phantom (Mini-boss):the guardian of the Temporal Ocean

-🧭 Features
- Unique structures & hand-designed AI-generated textures
- Custom tools like the Chrono Blade with time-based powers
- 2 new armor set and multiple new materials
- A new advancements tree
- A lore-rich experience that encourages exploration, experimentation, and storytelling
- 100% AI-created ideas, models, and art — human-polished for playability
- Built with MCreator 2025.2 for Minecraft 1.21+

🎯 Goal
This mod is an experiment in what AI creativity + human imagination can achieve together. No reused content. No filler. Just pure originality from another timeline.

Minecraft Version: 1.21.4 "_NeoForge for (1.21.4 21.4.137)_"
